town.label: Village
town.win: Wins when every other faction is gone.

mafia.label: Mafia
mafia.win: Wins when the Mafia equal or outnumber everyone else.

cult.label: Cult
cult.win: Wins when the Cult equals or outnumbers everyone else.

loyal.text: Cannot be recruited by the Cult

bomb.text: Whoever kills them is killed in return

villager.name: Villager
villager.summary: No night action. Wins with the Village through discussion and the vote.

loyal_villager.name: Loyal Villager
loyal_villager.summary: A Villager the Cult cannot recruit.

doctor.name: Doctor
doctor.summary: Each night, protects one player from a kill. A Strongman's kill still lands.

cop.name: Cop
cop.summary: Each night, investigates one player and learns whether they read Village or Scum.

hooker.name: Hooker
hooker.summary: Each night, blocks one player's action from resolving.

bomb.name: Bomb
bomb.summary: A Villager who takes their killer down with them.

mafia_goon.name: Mafia Goon
mafia_goon.summary: Carries the Mafia's shared kill, one per night.

cult_leader.name: Cult Leader
cult_leader.summary: Each night, recruits one player into the Cult. Loyal players refuse.

cultist.name: Cultist
cultist.summary: Recruited by the Cult Leader. Wins with the Cult.

arsonist.name: Arsonist
arsonist.summary: Douses one player a night, then may ignite to kill everyone doused at once.
